description:
I am a Registered Nurse and lecturer, health researcher, and health-tech innovator. I am passionate about leveraging AI and technology to solve real-world healthcare challenges. 

I already have a team of four talented members and we are excited to welcome an AI expert to strengthen our team. We value creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to building impactful solutions.

If you are passionate about AI, healthcare innovation,making a difference, we would love to have you join us!
